categories.label: Production Delivery
categories.description: features and services shipped to real users, with the candidate's own contribution and outcomes visible. Duty lists score low; delivered results score high.

categories.label: Engineering Quality & Design
categories.description: sound design at the component and service level: data modelling, APIs, auth, testing, performance fixes, and reasoned technical decisions. Full system architecture is not expected at this level.

categories.label: Technical Skills
categories.description: solid command of a primary language and framework backed by work evidence, plus working breadth across databases, cloud, containers, CI/CD and testing.

categories.label: Ownership & Collaboration
categories.description: independently owning pieces of work end to end, working across roles and stakeholders, code review, onboarding or helping peers. Formal leadership is a bonus, not a requirement.

bonus_description: senior-level signals shown early (leading a project, mentoring, designing beyond your area), technical writing or teaching, open source contribution, relevant certifications, side projects with real users.
